STAGE is a competitive football management platform where you play, manage, and grow. Here's a quick overview of how everything works.
fr: STAGE est une plateforme de gestion football compétitive où tu joues, gères et progresses. Voici un aperçu rapide de son fonctionnement.

en: Your club starts with 50,000 STC (Stage Currency). Use it to sign players, pay salaries, and build your squad. Manage your transfer budget and wage budget wisely.

en: STAGE has two separate currencies. Credits are used for platform features like tournaments and subscriptions. STC (Stage Currency) is the in-game economy — used for salaries, transfers, and lifestyle.
fr: STAGE a deux monnaies distinctes. Les crédits servent aux fonctionnalités de la plateforme comme les tournois et abonnements. Les STC sont l'économie du jeu — salaires, transferts et lifestyle.
